root.label: Translation Units & Linkage
root.note: Source files become isolated translation units whose symbols coordinate through linkage and the One Definition Rule.

children.label: Translation Phases
children.note: Nine ordered compilation phases turn source text and headers into linked object code.

children.label: Preprocessing (Phase 4)
children.note: Textually splices included headers and expands macros to form one translation unit.

children.label: Semantic Analysis (Phase 7)
children.note: Compiles one translation unit in isolation without inspecting neighboring source files.

children.label: Linking (Phase 9)
children.note: Merges compiled translation units and resolves external symbol references across the program.

children.label: Three Orthogonal Axes
children.note: Every declared entity independently carries a scope, storage duration, and linkage.

children.label: Scope
children.note: Compile-time lookup rule determining where an unqualified identifier can be resolved.

children.label: Storage Duration
children.note: Lifetime rule specifying when an object's storage is allocated and destroyed.

children.label: Linkage
children.note: Identity rule deciding whether declarations in different scopes or TUs name the same entity.

children.label: Linkage Kinds
children.note: C++ partitions declarations into no linkage, internal, external, or module linkage.

children.label: No Linkage
children.note: Block-scope locals and static local variables are never shared by name across scopes.

children.label: Internal Linkage
children.note: Namespace-scope static, unnamed namespaces, and plain const globals stay private to one TU.

children.label: External Linkage
children.note: Non-static globals, classes, and inline entities resolve to the same symbol program-wide.

children.label: Module Linkage
children.note: Non-exported entities inside a module purview are shared across that module's units only.

children.label: One Definition Rule
children.note: Limits how many definitions an entity may have per translation unit and program-wide.

children.label: Single Program Definition
children.note: Each odr-used non-inline external entity must have exactly one definition in the program.

children.label: Inline & Template Merging
children.note: Classes, templates, and inline entities allow one identical definition per translation unit.

children.label: IFNDR Mismatch
children.note: Token or lookup mismatches across TUs make the program ill-formed with no diagnostic required.

children.label: Language & ABI Linkage
children.note: Controls calling conventions, name mangling, and TU-local exposure boundaries.

children.label: extern "C" Blocks
children.note: Selects C ABI linkage while braced variable declarations without extern still define storage.

children.label: TU-Local Entities
children.note: Internal-linkage entities cannot be exposed via external inline functions or module exports.
